text:
emma_sales: Quick sync: Prospect 'AtlasBank' wants a 10-day POC. Requirements: EU-only tenant, mandatory BYOK, keys must be region-bound to eu-west-1 (Ireland). They want frankfurt (eu-central-1) allowed only for compute failover but key material must never be used there unless customer explicitly replicates keys. Also need subprocessors CSV, a one-line KMS statement for their questionnaire, and a rough cost uplift for tenant pinning. cc @raju_sre @laura_security

 raju_sre: We can support on Dedicated or Private. Hosted cannot give strong guarantees for region-bound BYOK. For strict key-region binding + compute failover constraints recommend Dedicated.

 laura_security: Subprocessors short CSV for procurement: "AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP (europe-west3), Azure (northeurope), Cloudflare, Fastly, Datadog, Sentry, HashiCorp Vault". Sending signed CSV to presales folder.

 emma_sales: One-liner for their security questionnaire (they asked for a crisp sentence):

 laura_security: "Customer-managed, HSM-backed BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private with optional region scoping; keys are under customer control during import and HSM attestation is available. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; Hosted-BYOK may be provided under a legal addendum and extra attestation."

 raju_sre: Important operational note: If keys are region-locked to eu-west-1, compute failover to eu-central-1 will be blocked unless the customer pre-replicates keys to eu-central-1 or grants an MSA exception allowing wrapped key usage in failover. Two patterns we typically present: (1) "blocked_if_key_unavailable" - failover blocked and errors returned, (2) "failover_with_replication" - customer replicates keys (customer-managed) and failover works. Must pick one.

 emma_sales: They want a minimal routing policy snippet to show infra folks. Keep it tiny.

 raju_sre: Minimal example (shareable):

 ```json
 { "tenant":"atlasbank-poc", "routing":{"mode":"tenant_pin","primary":"eu-west-1","failover":["eu-central-1"], "failover_behavior":"blocked_if_key_unavailable"}, "kms":{"mode":"byok_hsm","region_bind":"eu-west-1","replication":"customer_if_needed"} }
 ```

 laura_security: Add this note to questionnaire: "If region_bind is set, cross-region failover requires customer-managed key replication or an explicit contractual exception; BYOK import and attestation typically take 3-7 business days after PO."

 emma_sales: They asked about cost uplift and latency sizing. They estimate peak 20 rps, avg seq 150 tokens and want token p95 ~60ms. Any quick sizing + ballpark uplift?

 raju_sre: Quick calc: 20 rps * 150 tokens = 3000 tokens/sec (~180k tokens/min). With KV caching and batching we often see 1.5x efficiency. To hit ~60ms p95 we'd use low-concurrency GPU shapes and reserve capacity. Ballpark: 1-2 reserved GPUs with a hot standby for failover. Uplift: reservation fee (~$4k-$8k/mo) + per-token price uplift around 15-30% depending on model & instance mix. Exact quote requires model choice and target qps.

 laura_security: Also call out egress / billing: cross-region failover may introduce egress charges and could change latency SLAs. If they require zero cross-region egress, we must enforce failover blocking.

 emma_sales: Can you drop a tiny latency test script they can run from their Ireland office to validate p95 before kickoff?

 raju_sre: Sure, tiny script (bash):

 ```bash
 # run from customer's Ireland office
 for i in {1..200}; do
   t0=$(date +%s%3N)
   curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' >/dev/null
   t1=$(date +%s%3N)
   echo $((t1-t0))
 done | sort -n | awk 'NR==int(0.95*NR){print "p95:"$1}'
 ```

 laura_security: Ops timeline notes: Dedicated tenant provisioning 5-10 business days after PO + capacity commit. BYOK HSM import & attestation adds ~3-7 business days. Need from customer: CIDR (if VPC peering), confirmation of failover behavior, and whether they can replicate keys to eu-central-1.

 ops_bot: Upload automated: presales/atlasbank/attestations.zip and subprocessors_signed.csv at 2026-03-01T08:45:00Z. Ticket created POC-4410.

 emma_sales: Great. I'll send the subprocessors CSV, the KMS one-liner, the routing snippet and the test script. I'll ask them to confirm key replication choice and CIDR. Thanks team :thumbsup:
